description: The jealous maids tell the Queen the new girl can spin a pound of flax in a day, though she has never seen a spinning wheel, and then a very long nose comes round the door. A Norwegian folktale, retold in crisp modern English.
summary: Three old women spin, weave and sew for a poor hunter’s daughter at the King’s manor, and all they ask is to be called Aunt on her day of honour.
